description: This source file implements functions related to managing pack file geometries in a version control system, likely Git. It handles the initialization, splitting, selection, and removal of pack files based on their size and structure to optimize storage and retrieval.

methods.name: uint32_t pack_geometry_weight(struct packed_git * p)
methods.description: Calculates the weight (size) of a pack file.

methods.name: int pack_geometry_cmp(const void * va,const void * vb)
methods.description: Compares two pack files based on their weight for sorting.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_init(struct pack_geometry * geometry,struct existing_packs * existing,const struct pack_objects_args * args)
methods.description: Initializes the pack geometry structure by collecting relevant pack files, filtering based on criteria such as locality and keep flags, and sorts them.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_split(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Splits the list of pack files into groups based on geometric progression of their sizes.

methods.name: struct:packed_git * pack_geometry_preferred_pack(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Selects the preferred pack file, typically the largest that isn't part of the split.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_remove_redundant(struct pack_geometry * geometry,struct string_list * names,struct existing_packs * existing,const char * packdir)
methods.description: Removes redundant pack files that are not needed, based on a list of names and criteria.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_release(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the pack geometry structure.
